title: Surveillance Law and the 2026 Election
goal: I can sum up the debate about the rules of covert surveillance before the election of 2026 and the change of government, with dates (*szabályozás, visszaélés, rendelet*).
I can name a procedure with a verbal noun in *-ás/-és* (*a megfigyelés bírói engedélyezését*).
I can report, with attribution, what each side proposed or held.
